questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.The intersection of technology and art has given rise to innovative forms of creative expression. Digital art, in particular, has democratised the art world, allowing artists to showcase their work globally. However, this increased accessibility has also raised concerns about authorship and ownership. The ease with which digital art can be reproduced and disseminated has led to debates about intellectual property rights.The concept of 'ownership' is further complicated by the emergence of artificial intelligence-generated art. AI algorithms can produce stunning visual and auditory experiences, but who owns these creations? Is it the programmer who designed the algorithm or the AI itself? These questions highlight the need for updated copyright laws that address the complexities of digital art.Moreover, digital art challenges traditional notions of art as a tangible object. Digital installations, for instance, exist solely in the virtual realm, defying conventional notions of space and materiality. This shift has sparked discussions about the role of museums and galleries in preserving and showcasing digital art.As technology continues to evolve, the boundaries between art and science will increasingly blur. Artists will need to collaborate with programmers and engineers to push the frontiers of creative expression. The resulting fusion of art and technology will yield new forms of storytelling, expanding our understanding of what it means to be human.According to the passage, digital art has _________.
options: eliminated the need for museums and galleries
limited the accessibility of art to a global audience
raised concerns about authorship and ownership
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (raised concerns about authorship and ownership) है।
